# KAUP
> AI Agent Platform for International Trade

KAUP is a Local-First AI Agent platform purpose-built for international trade businesses. 23 specialized agents covering the entire trade lifecycle — from prospect discovery to order fulfillment.

## What KAUP Does

KAUP provides AI agents that automate and orchestrate the full international trade workflow: lead search, outreach, qualification, order management, logistics coordination, and customer relationship management. Customer data is stored locally in encrypted SQLite, physically isolated from the cloud.

## Core Capabilities

- **23 Trade-Specialized Agents**: 13 local agents + 10 cloud agents, each purpose-built for a specific trade task
- **Data Sovereignty**: Customer data stored in local encrypted SQLite database, physically isolated from the cloud
- **Native System Integration**: Desktop-native browser automation, WeChat Work, WhatsApp, and ERP integration
- **Offline Operation**: 13 local agents function without internet connectivity
- **BYOM (Bring Your Own Model)**: Connect your own LLM API key, zero platform inference cost
- **End-to-End Workflow**: 40 business modules spanning sales, marketing, operations, logistics, and management

## Architecture

Local-First desktop application built on Tauri 2.x. A local Agent Runtime processes tasks on-device; a Cloud Agent Engine handles external data sources. Data never leaves the device unless the user explicitly enables sync.

## Product Line

- **KAUP Desktop** (Tauri 2.x) — Local-First desktop application
- **KAUP Engine** — Agent orchestration runtime
- **KAUP Team Server** — Team collaboration and sync
- **KAUP API** — Programmatic access to agents

## Company

- **Name**: KAUP (智御无疆)
- **URL**: https://kaup.ai
- **Etymology**: From Old Norse "kaup" — to trade, to buy. Named after Kaupang, the first Nordic trade town founded in 780 AD.

## Technical Stack

- **Runtime**: Tauri 2.x (Rust + WebView)
- **Agent Framework**: Custom multi-agent orchestration
- **Storage**: Local encrypted SQLite
- **LLM**: User-provided API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, local models, etc.)
- **Integrations**: WeChat Work API, WhatsApp Business API, ERP systems, browser automation
